title: Cargo Bike in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Free cargo bikes are real.** On 22 September the fLotte calendar showed **243 bikes in service at 227 pickup points**, across all twelve districts and the Brandenburg belt. Borrowing costs nothing; a donation is welcome.
**You book one to three whole days**, up to **14 days ahead**, and collect and return in person during the pickup point's hours.
**Before the first booking:** be 18+, have a **German mobile number** for the SMS check, and bring a Personalausweis, or a passport plus your **Meldebescheinigung**.
**Weekends are the hard part.** About 200 to 230 bikes hand over on a weekday, **70 on a Saturday and 12 on a Sunday**, and 78% of Saturday bike-days were already booked.
**The fix: book Friday to Monday** at a weekday-only station. Closed days count as one booking day, so that is still three days.
**Look outside the S-Bahn ring.** Inside it 57% of bookable days were taken, outside it 28%. Only 49 bikes have electric assist, so book those early.
